author: Juan Siro
description: NOC module for processes, tasks, transactions, Assets, alerts, logs, and framework control

description_lang.es: Permite administrar procesos, tareas, transacciones y Assets de NOC, además de enviar alertas, registrar logs y controlar la detención del framework.
description_lang.en: Manages NOC processes, tasks, transactions, and Assets, and also sends alerts, writes logs, and controls framework shutdown.
description_lang.pr: Permite administrar processos, tarefas, transações e Assets do NOC, além de enviar alertas, registrar logs e controlar a parada do framework.
